passages.text: The figure of number of hydro projects damaged varies from 4, 5, 8 to 11 HEP projects.
At least 9 human beings were killed in the disaster.
18 individuals including 12 Nepali and 6 Chinese nationals went missing.
Shutting down of about 250 MW capacity generation from 7 HEPs.

SANDRP lists damaged operational plants as Rasuwagadhi 111 MW, Chilime 22 MW, Trishuli 3A 60 MW, Trishuli 25.25 MW and Devighat 14 MW, plus under-construction projects Upper Trishuli 3B 37 MW, Upper Trishuli 1 216 MW and Super Trishuli 100 MW. Water level in the Lhende river rose by 3.5 metres at Timure; initial financial losses were estimated above NPR 5 billion.

source.publisher: SANDRP (South Asia Network on Dams, Rivers and People)
